method: pdftoppm full-page render + Read tool (Claude Code allotment; no Anthropic API)

contributions.detail: Cover lines 1 and 2 carry a hand-drawn slashed zero in all six cells (= 0 per the zero-glyph ruling; the verbatim glyph is a circle with a stroke through it). Form A (page 2) is an entirely EMPTY ruled schedule: rows sum 0 = cover line 1. All three columns are zero, so the THIS and CUMULATIVE scopes coincide; recorded as cumulative on that coincidence. This candidate self-funded and reported no contributions at all.

expenditures.detail: 4 rows sum to EXACTLY 332.77 (115.31 + 51.17 + 25.58 + 140.71). That equals cover line 3's LAST REPORT and CUMULATIVE cells (both 332.77) and the filer's own hand-written 332.77 on the line below row 4 (reached by a long diagonal lead-in stroke; the Carr form prints no schedule total, so this figure is the FILER's addition). It does NOT equal the THIS REPORT cell, which is a slashed zero. ***SCOPE WARNING: this filing reports ZERO expenditure for the period yet RE-LISTS THE WHOLE CYCLE on Form B.*** The rows are therefore CUMULATIVE, and a cycle sum that also counts this filer's earlier filing would double-count. Note too that the last row is dated 10/11/16 while the cover's THIS-period cell is zero and the form is signed 12/8/2016 - the filer treated everything as already reported.

gates.page_subtotal: p3 rows sum 332.77 = the filer-written 332.77 = cover line 3 LAST 332.77 = cover line 3 CUM 332.77. The Carr form prints no schedule total of its own.
gates.row_count: ink-projection over p3's amount column (x_200 1400-1620) returns exactly FIVE thick inked bands among the printed rules: four data rows (y_200 267-307, 319-355, 366-398, 414-445) and one tall band at 456-534 which is the filer's diagonal lead-in stroke plus the 332.77 total. 4 rows emitted. Form A's amount column returns zero inked bands.
gates.geometry_proof: p3 rows 1-4 were crop-proved in one 600 dpi band (y_200 217-483) which renders those four rows and nothing else; the control two row-pitches below the last row (y_200 523-597) renders empty rules plus the tail of the total's diagonal stroke. Row bands MEASURED by ink projection, not interpolated.
gates.balance_chain: LAST + THIS = CUM closes on lines 1, 2, 3 and 4 (all THIS cells are slashed zeros). The period identity does NOT close as signed arithmetic: contributions cum 0 - expenses cum 332.77 = -332.77, while line 4 prints 332.77 with no minus sign and no parentheses. As on the Zilles cover in this chunk, the printed balance is the MAGNITUDE of a negative balance; both figures retained verbatim, nothing recomputed. No earlier filing by this filer is in this chunk, so the cross-filing LAST-column chain could not be run here - which matters here, because the cumulative scope means an earlier filing very likely carries these same four rows.
